liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cosmic Charlie** (1 review): The intro to this track is described as delightfully raunchy [2]

## The recordings

- **gd70-07-10.aud.cotsman.17351.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 88 min; rated 3.18/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener feels crowded in a back hallway, hearing gleeful crowd reactions; Sound quality is noted as not great, but also not bad; Quality is not bad, providing a feeling of being present [2][3][4][8][10][12]

## Around the show

- Dead Book Skeleton Key author claims his first show was this date [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-07-10.aud.cotsman.17351.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Marty Weinberg; transferred by Jeff Cotsman; source: Audience [1]. Also: Marty taped the performance, allowing listeners to critique the audio quality; Set minus Not Fade Away circulated as 6-24-70 early or 6-25-70 late; Weinberg reels supply the Not Fade Away excerpt, matching no other 1970 version [1][8]
